intro: Lieutenant Aden sends you with the orc report you found to Captain Garran Vimes, who reads orcish better than most. News of Horde spies near Theramore is to go with it.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Captain Vimes should see the orc report you found, friend. He knows the orcish language better than most. And he should know that there are Horde spies near Theramore!
The captain is in the barracks, on the northeastern side of Theramore Isle.

clips.title: Completion
paras: A report from an orc spy! How did you find this? No matter -- let's see what it says...
